fusions.name: Drawn Venom
fusions.desc: Needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up. Flicks a sting at a target up to 6 tiles away for 9 poison damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach.

fusions.name: Bitter Hum
fusions.desc: A hum that deals 4 poison damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, with a 30% chance per hit to leave it [Damped], dealing less damage, for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Propolis Salve
fusions.desc: Removes up to 2 poison conditions from you and your allies, and restores 8 health.

fusions.name: Returned in Kind
fusions.desc: Each debuff laid on you has a 20% chance to be sent back to whoever laid it instead.
